# Healthcare Database

This folder catalogs specific technical and administrative variables utilized within the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) to extract, filter, and validate patient records. These parameters are essential for hospitals and regions conducting local data validation, allowing them to accurately delimit analysis periods, isolate precise patient populations, and link clinical episodes to specific hospital departments. Together, they ensure that the data reported to national registers accurately reflects the underlying clinical reality.

## Pages

- [[forloeb-sorkode|Forloeb_SORKode]] — Identifies clinical patient episodes and links them to specific hospital or department SOR codes for local data extraction.
- [[opereret-1|Opereret = 1]] — An administrative variable that isolates the subset of patients possessing both an inclusion diagnosis and an inclusion operation.
- [[t-0|T_0]] — A technical parameter used for period delimitation to restrict data extracts to a specific analysis time-frame.
